sources.title: Flux2-Klein-9B-True-V1 vs Flux2-Klein-9B-True-V3 - aimodels.fyi
sources.snippet: Flux2-Klein-9B-True-V1 is a fine-tuned variant of the FLUX.2-klein-9B text-to-image model, created by wikeeyang. The model generates images from text descriptions using a 9 billion parameter rectified flow transformer architecture and supports image editing and inpainting capabilities.
